items.name: kinetic-text
items.title: Kinetic Text
items.description: A headline that reveals word by word with spring motion, blur, and an accent glow. Plain Remotion, no UI library.

items.name: motion-text
items.title: Motion Text
items.description: A word on a soft gradient pill that springs up into place. Five colour presets, no fonts to load.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: A masked slide-up reveal. Each letter or word rises out of a clipped row on its own spring.

items.name: spinning-text-wheel
items.title: Spinning Text Wheel
items.description: A 3D drum of options that spins down and settles on the first line, like a slot reel picking a winner.
